column3: The Hebrew says “appointed” and refers to the gates of the LORD’s camps; BSB says “reestablished” and “the LORD’s dwelling.”
The Hebrew says that they may be strong in the Law of the LORD; BSB says that they could devote themselves to it.
The Hebrew repeats “heaps, heaps”; BSB says “large heaps.”
The Hebrew describes eating, being satisfied, and leaving much over; BSB expresses this as having enough to eat and plenty left over.
The Hebrew says “the holy things of holy things”; BSB says “the consecrated gifts.”
The Hebrew says “their brothers” and “great and small”; BSB specifies “their fellow priests” and “old and young.”
The Hebrew says “in every city and city”; BSB additionally distinguishes “any other city.”
The Hebrew explicitly says he acted with all his heart; BSB expresses this as being diligent.
